# Requirements Quality Checklist: Mobile OTP Authentication

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurable quality of the OTP authentication requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-14
**Feature**: [../spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are request limits defined for both mobile number and source, including their thresholds and reset windows? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 Are session lifetime, expiry, revocation, and behavior across multiple devices specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all outcomes of SMS delivery failure, delayed delivery, duplicate requests, and provider unavailability defined? [Coverage, Spec §Story 3, §FR-003, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK004 Are signup/sign-in responses and their information-disclosure boundaries specified for every stage before and after number verification? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004–006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the exact accepted Indian mobile-number format defined, including local number length, prefixes, whitespace, and punctuation normalization? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the OTP format explicitly settled between the six-digit assumption and the functional requirement's unspecified code length? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the semantics of a resend clear about whether it invalidates prior codes, resets attempt counts, or preserves lockouts? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the post-authentication destination's allowed format and fallback behavior fully defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Are the resend cooldown, OTP expiry, attempt threshold, block duration, and request-rate-limit statements consistent across clarifications, requirements, edge cases, and assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-007, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 Is account-existence privacy consistently preserved in request acknowledgment, error messaging, and registration/sign-in flows? [Consistency, Spec §Story 3, §FR-004, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK011 Are number-change behavior and challenge-to-number binding consistent with request replacement and old-code invalidation rules? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-009]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Is the 10-second valid-code completion target measured from a clearly defined event and under stated SMS/service conditions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Are usability completion targets and mobile-screen criteria tied to defined viewport, participant, and sample conditions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-004, §SC-006]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Are concurrent OTP requests and verification attempts addressed so rate limits, supersession, and one-time use remain unambiguous? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK015 Are lockout recovery and behavior after the 15-minute block expires explicitly defined? [Recovery, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK016 Are user-facing recovery paths specified for wrong, expired, reused, mismatched-number codes, SMS failure, and service outage? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §Story 3, §FR-006, §FR-008, §FR-013]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK017 Are accessibility requirements defined for OTP entry, countdown announcements, validation feedback, and recovery actions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK018 Are privacy and retention requirements specified for phone numbers, challenge metadata, rate-limit data, and authentication logs? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]

## Dependencies, Assumptions, and Ambiguities

- [ ] CHK019 Are SMS provider delivery guarantees, supported destinations, cost/availability expectations, and failure ownership documented? [Dependency, Spec §FR-003, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the SMS-provider choice and regulatory responsibilities assigned to a decision owner and deployment boundary? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
